summary: Your fifteenth teach-back. You answer a colleague who merges when the tests are green, explain how to review code written by an agent in 5 sentences, check six key points, and test your explanation against what real reviews found that green tests did not.
goal: Explain how to review AI-written code.

items.text: Write what you would answer the colleague, one thing tests miss and one thing a quick read misses
Explain how to review AI-written code in 5 sentences or a 60-second voice note
Tick the six key points your explanation said clearly and count them
Check your explanation against the real findings and how each was found
Write a better sentence for the biggest gap
Play the Review Like a PR game to the end and see your score
